title: Kingdom of the Fairies
shortDescription: A hand-tinted theatrical adventure inspired by Georges Méliès’s 1903 silent film. Voyage through enchanted seas and climb a burning tower to rescue Azurine.
description: Step onto a painted toy-theatre stage and play through a fairy-tale voyage inspired by Georges Méliès’s Le Royaume des fées (1903). Guide the prince from a royal betrothal through a shipwreck, the Water Fairy’s grotto, Neptune’s court, a whale’s passage, and an enchanted tower. Walk, leap, swim, climb, and face the witch in scenes brought to life with hand-tinted imagery, theatrical scenery, and period-style instrumental music. Checkpoints and unlocked scenes let you return to the adventure as it unfolds.

controls.keyboard: Arrows or WASD to move. Follow the on-screen prompts: Space performs the scene’s primary action; Up/W jumps in walking scenes; X interacts or is held to bow where indicated. P pauses. Full instructions appear in play.
controls.gamepad: Left stick or D-pad to move. A jumps or acts, X interacts/bows where prompted, B goes back or skips where available, and Menu pauses.
controls.touch: Use the on-screen touch controls and gestures taught in each scene. Play in landscape.

reviewerNotes: This is a playable adaptation, not a film viewer. Its opening prologue is interactive and leads into six acts with varied traversal and action mechanics.
The hand-tinted, painted toy-theatre presentation and silent-film pacing are intentional. This distribution includes only the film edition and colorized cast.

New players enter the opening act introduction automatically. Introductory cards advance without mandatory confirmation; the SDK gameplay signal starts at a playable scene, not at a static card or loading screen.
The CrazyGames HTML5 v3 SDK is initialized before the game reads progress. Enable SDK Data module progress saving. Guests can play.
No external advertising or custom analytics are included. Monetization is not integrated in this submission package.
Artwork and period-style recordings include generated material. Complete any applicable portal disclosure accurately; this draft does not certify distribution rights.
